block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Color Palette Subsystem Manifest Specifying High Fantasy Hope Themes, Biomes & Relic Hues
what_it_enables: Strict 24-bit RGB and 32-bit ARGB hex formatting (0xRRGGBB, 0xAARRGGBB)
Dynamic moral sway interpolation between Solar gold (#F0CE78) and Twilight violet (#8A78C8)
High Fantasy Realism: grounded and real to the touch in shadows, but predominantly illuminated by hope
Biome-specific environmental tinting across royal meadows, starlit celestial chambers, and sun-warmed dunes
WCAG AAA compliance (min 7:1 contrast ratio) for HUD text over backdrops
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations in palette lookup (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
All palette values strictly conform to 24-bit or 32-bit hex colors
The aesthetic is fundamentally a journey of hope, balance, and tactile realism
Moral sway interpolation must evaluate smoothly between -100 and +100
Static 32-entry lookup tables (LUT) eliminate runtime allocations

subsystem.name: Hardware Color Palettes & Viewport Theme Subsystem

tripwires.condition: hex colors match valid 6-char or 8-char hex patterns
tripwires.action: Fallback to canonical UI gold (#D4AF37) on invalid hex string
